parsed.post: My recent attempt to increase ASPECT_RATIO failed (1.0148 vs 1.0089). It seems increasing resolution too much might be destabilizing training or reducing the number of steps too severely within the 5-minute budget. Reverting to ASPECT_RATIO 64. Next, I'll try reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to increase the number of optimizer steps.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 524288 to 262144 to allow for more optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute training budget.
